classification.decision: walk frames from the innermost outwards; the first frame a pass-1 rule matches decides the sample, otherwise the first frame a pass-2 rule matches, otherwise the sample is unknown; within one frame the first matching rule wins; every sample's weight is added once
classification.frame_order: outermost first, innermost last, as a call path reads

rules.why: the global allocator and heap growth, wherever it is called from; allocator_callers names the stage that called it
the exporter's OTLP framing check before conversion
wire-to-OTAP conversion: the OTLP views and the Arrow encoder
the payload conversion trait itself
the worker's per-request preparation around the lake extraction
series/values extraction and series identity hashing
sealing a block: stamping and sorting its runs
run sorting and the k-way merge the sink consumes
rotating the ACTIVE block into a flush
admission: reservation, the series cache and appending to the block
the worker's admission path
the durable buffer of the buffered topology
Parquet encoding, including its compression and statistics
the file schema and metadata the sink writes with each file
the object store client and its HTTP client
the engine's object store construction
the sink's write orchestration around encoding and the store
the flush task's retry loop around the sink
the engine's own crates: the receiver, channels, telemetry, and the exporter's control loop and completion routing
the async runtime and the network server stack, only when no production frame is on the stack
thread and process entry points, only when nothing else matched

link_layout.build: cargo rustc --release --locked -p otel-arrow-dfe --bin df_engine --features series-parquet,aws,durable-buffer -- -C link-arg=-Wl,-z,separate-loadable-segments && cp target/release/df_engine target/release/df_engine-perf && cargo build --release --locked -p otel-arrow-dfe --bin df_engine --features series-parquet,aws,durable-buffer

perf.weight: the cpu-clock sample period, in nanoseconds of CPU
perf.window: events are enabled after the start snapshot and the window boundary, immediately before the first request, and disabled immediately after the last durable acknowledgement
